b: Oklou is taking her ethereal pop to the movies. The French singer-songwriter has announced an original score for In Waves, Phuong Mai Nguyen’s animated feature steeped in SoCal surf culture, and shared its first track, “The Swirl Ahead.” The soundtrack is available to pre-order now, including limited vinyl and CD editions, ahead of the film’s premiere on Netflix on December 11.

Oklou composed and performed the score with fellow French musician ROB, whose screen credits include the spy series The Bureau and Mounia Meddour’s Papicha. Adapted from AJ Dungo’s graphic memoir about losing his partner to cancer, and featuring the voices of Stephanie Hsu and Will Sharpe, In Waves opened Cannes’s Critics’ Week in May, the first animated feature to do so.

The score caps a busy stretch for Oklou, born Marylou Mayniel, whose 2025 album Choke Enough landed at #16 on our list of the best albums of last year. Check out our review of Oklou’s spring tour stop in Washington, D.C.
